article.title: Google finds another way to push Search users to AI Mode
article.summary: TL;DR Some Google Search queries are returning fully expanded AI Overview summaries. These expanded summaries include a text box labeled Ask anything that links to AI Mode. It seems this is only the case on desktop. Google’s been working at making AI Mode a more prominent part of Search for some time. Now, it’s taken another step to that end: some AI Overview summaries are now showing up fully expanded, complete with a text box where you can type follow-up questions that’ll launch an AI Mode interaction. Previously, these text boxes only appeared when you clicked Show more at the bottom of an AI Overview. article.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
article.summary: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

article.title: Anthropic Seals $35 Billion Cloud Deal With Nvidia-Backed Lambda
article.summary: Anthropic PBC agreed to a $35 billion computing deal with Lambda, a cloud provider backed by Nvidia Corp., part of an effort to quickly expand its AI capacity, according to a person familiar with the matter.
